findings.message: Authorization logic is inverted: the middleware now rejects admin users with 403 and lets non-admin authenticated users through (next()). This defeats requireAdmin entirely — any authenticated non-admin can access admin routes while actual admins are blocked.
findings.suggestion: Restore the negated condition: `if (!user.isAdmin) { res.status(403)... }` so only users with user.isAdmin === true proceed to next().

findings.message: The hunk adds a new exported isAdminUser function, but an identical isAdminUser already exists in the file (shown at line 49 / in the enclosing context). This creates a duplicate export/function declaration and will fail compilation with a duplicate identifier error.
findings.suggestion: Remove the newly added copy of isAdminUser; keep only the existing one.
